items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Holder was the manager. He used to go down and collect the money.

ctx.x: But we weren't making it, Holder was the manager.

OH HOLDER WAS THE MANAGER.
Holder was the manager. He used to go down and collect the money. So for at least almost six months, over five months he was getting all this extra money, now we noticed a fool and his money. He came up with this new car and we said oh, where did he go and get this brand new Buick. At that time the Buicks went back to Packard, it was a gorgeous thing. So we became suspicious and we said to Trent well you had better go down and see what's happening down there, maybe the Adolphis has…
Well, anyway that's when he stopped manager.
